scope: Event provenance closure and regressions only; this verdict does not represent the full host
decision: The exact Mega Darkrai ex source is byte-verified, the replacement remains a contained identity composition across 390/536/1280, and all frozen Event content, interaction, runtime and business-safety checks pass without regression.

assetProvenance.evidence: Fresh retrieval of the exact CloudFront URL and the local 330x460 PNG both contain 386826 bytes and share SHA-256 e4b59f83713045deb5eb8d84590533188c4392c3c5543839cd5af2f9018daf41. Frozen inventory contains exact URL records as dom-image and dom-srcset, alt=Mega Darkrai ex, shouldMigrate=true.

implementationIntegrity.evidence: The runtime asset is an exact standalone upstream image, not a screenshot, crop or reference-derived full-frame raster. CSS contains it inside the established navy identity field.

identityComposition.evidence: At 390 the logo and card form a compact masthead above content; at 536 the card becomes the right-side anchor; at 1280 the logo and card form one bounded event vignette. The portrait card remains contained and does not read as an unrelated pasted poster.

contentAndFirstScreenBudget.evidence: All viewports preserve title, live status, four metrics, schedule heading, first round, top-deck row and round action in the first screen. Two round cards, two top decks, two actions and four metrics remain in DOM. No visible title clipping was observed; the numeric clipped probe is only a subpixel rounding equality.

interactionParity.evidence: Round and top-deck actions navigate correctly by pointer, Enter and Space. Each is role=button, tabIndex=0, restores the Event URL on Back and remains stable after reload.

runtimeAndBusinessSafety.evidence: All three Event renders have 0px document overflow, zero failed requests, zero non-GET writes and no visible animations under reduced motion. Both identity assets resolve locally.

otherRoutes.evidence: Fresh 390px Plaza, Build, Mine, Round and Detail captures exactly match the Attempt13 implementation self-check hashes and each reports 0px overflow and zero writes. Build, Mine, Round and Detail also match Attempt12 byte-for-byte; Plaza reflects its separately accepted later iteration rather than an Event regression.
